headline: Independent Nomination Board

meeting.summary: The board formed one TIG to interview applicants and, after closed-door interviews, voted to send names to several boards.
meeting.recap: The Independent Nomination Board met with all five members present.[[0:00:31]] The board voted to have two members represent it at the Maui County Fair.[[0:14:32]] Voters will decide in November on a charter change that would dissolve the board.[[0:17:27]] The board voted, with five ayes, to form two TIGs, small groups of members, to interview, score and recommend applicants.[[0:30:36]] The board voted five to zero to let staff confirm reappointments for the board.[[0:32:21]] The board voted, with five ayes, on a new motion to form one TIG instead.[[0:40:58]] After a second closed-door session, the board said it interviewed six applicants.[[0:50:07]] The board said it voted to send names to boards including the Board of Water Supply and the Housing Advisory Board.[[0:50:54]] The next meeting was confirmed for the 23rd at 3:30.[[1:04:22]]
decided: The board approved two members to represent it at the Maui County Fair.
The board voted to go into executive session to interview applicants.
The board approved forming two TIGs to interview, score and recommend applicants.
The board approved letting staff confirm reappointments and send them to the appointing body for the board.
The board approved a new motion to form one TIG to interview, score and recommend applicants.
The board voted to go back into executive session.
The board reported it voted in executive session to send names to several boards and none to liquor control.
meeting.next: Suggested future recruiting events were deferred to the next meeting. The list of members whose terms end was not ready, so that item was deferred. Staff agreed to bring a plan and timeline for the TIG to the next meeting.
